dossiers.title: The Emiya table measures care through competence and comedy
dossiers.claim: The household meals establish Sakura's learned competence and the uncertain history of her continued help: breakfast names exact dishes and states that she has surpassed Shirou, dinner explains the technique he praises, and Shirou frames Taiga's newspaper act and his own memory with explicit uncertainty; mirror moon generalizes the food, lowers Sakura's competence, changes the cooking method, and hardens both uncertain accounts.
dossiers.sourcePattern: Named ingredients and preparations, an explicit completed comparison between pupil and teacher, surface browning before simmering, speculative のか framing tied to Taiga's performance, and Shirou's evasive 気がする recollection.
dossiers.mirrorMoonEffect: The household rhythm survives, but Sakura's practical accomplishment becomes less exact, the praised method changes, and two bounded inferences become more certain than Shirou's narration.
dossiers.limits: The dossier records the reviewed household meal scenes, preserves their differences in culinary scope, and does not infer Taiga's actual prior-night activity or settle why Sakura kept visiting.
dossiers.diagnostic: 355 retained findings after re-review; 8 cited passages.

dossiers.title: Magecraft terminology, circuits, and technical explanation
dossiers.claim: The prologue and Shirou's training scenes repeatedly lose distinctions among magical categories, practitioners, circuits, conversion, structural diagnosis, and Strengthening.
dossiers.sourcePattern: The explicit contrasts among 魔法使い, 魔法, 魔術, and 魔術使い; circuit count and conversion; inherited theory; and the successive stages and limits of Strengthening.
dossiers.mirrorMoonEffect: The system remains recognizable in outline, but terms collapse, quantities become qualities, mechanisms contradict themselves, and dangerous failures can read as successful alignment or improvement.
dossiers.limits: Terminology follows the work's Japanese contrasts and the bound critical edition; the dossier records reviewed explanations rather than imposing a complete external taxonomy.
dossiers.diagnostic: 1,298 retained findings after re-review; 8 cited passages.

dossiers.title: Servant detection, class, and capability boundaries
dossiers.claim: The tour distinguishes being detectable from detecting others, magical perception from eyesight, and class identity from a complete limit on skills; key English lines reverse or broaden those boundaries.
dossiers.sourcePattern: Strong magical energy as an easier target, class-specific limitations on remote detection, and Archer's correction through swordsmanship and magecraft.
dossiers.mirrorMoonEffect: Who senses whom is reversed once, and a specific cross-class skill claim becomes a general mastery of weaponry.
dossiers.limits: The dossier records local explanations and Rin's inferences rather than certifying a complete combat-system taxonomy.
dossiers.diagnostic: 331 retained findings after re-review; 8 cited passages.
